input.quote: 15.12 Independent Contractors. It is expressly agreed that RevMed and Sanofi shall be independent contractors and that the relationship between the two Parties shall not constitute a partnership, joint venture or agency.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no employee non-solicitation or no-hire covenant. Searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "non-solicitation" and "employment" return only unrelated hits (JSC agenda input, indemnity counsel, RevMed's IP-assignment reps), and a full read of GENERAL PROVISIONS (Article XV) and the RESEARCH article (Article IV, including the FTE/cost provisions) shows no restrictive covenant on personnel. Article XV runs from Force Majeure through Counterparts with no hiring restriction, and the only personnel-related obligation is RevMed's duty to make its technical employees available for tech transfer (p0359), which benefits us. This matches the preferred position — no non-solicit binding the Customer — so no redline is required.
